newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Saudi fixes coupons for five- and seven-year FRNs.
newsitem.headline: Saudi fixes coupons for five- and seven-year FRNs.

text.p: The Saudi Arabian Monetary Agency (SAMA) has offered five- and seven-year Floating Rate Notes (FRNs) worth two billion riyals ($533 million), a banker in the kingdom said on Wednesday.
He said the rate for five-year FRNs, offered on Saturday and on which coupons were fixed on Monday, was 6.30 percent. The rate on seven-year FRNs was 6.40 percent.
The rates are fixed at 30 basis points over the Saudi interbank offered rate for five years and 40 basis points over for seven years.
SAMA offers FRNs once a month to local banks.
